source:
@@U04653@@
Protect yourselves!
Huddle close!
Stand fast!
Ah! Ah!
They've lost it, their valor!
Where's courage gone?
My devils scent a strange, voluptuous glow.

@@U04655@@
Flowers so beautiful,
Flames burning bright,
On hearts that are dutiful
Shed pure delight,
Love every way.
Words with pure truth that ring,
Clear as heavens opening,
To hosts immortal bring
Everywhere day.

@@U04657@@
Ah, the fools! The dolts!
My Satans standing on their heads,
the fat ones turning cartwheels head over heels and
tumbling ass-first into Hell!
Oh, and I hope it agrees with you!
But I’m standing by my post, no matter what.

@@U04658@@
(Beating off the roses floating down around him.)

@@U04659@@
Will-o’-the-wisps, away!
Ah, you shine so brightly till Pve caught you,
and then you're a sticky mess
Away, I say! Now!
Ah, there’s something like pitch and sulfur
nipping at my neck!
RAUS, IPARimenEZOu 28 ef 9
translation:
@@U04653@@
保护好自己！
凑近了！
坚守！
啊!啊!
他们失去了勇气！
勇气去哪儿了？
我的魔鬼闻到了一种奇怪的、性感的光芒。

@@U04655@@
花儿真美丽，
火焰燃烧明亮，
在尽职尽责的心上
流露出纯粹的喜悦，
爱各方面。
带着纯粹真理的话语响起，
清澈如天开，
给主人不朽带来
处处日。

@@U04657@@
啊，傻瓜们！笨蛋们！
我的撒旦倒立着，
胖子们翻滚着，
屁股先跌入地狱！
哦，我希望你同意！
但无论如何，我都会坚持我的立场。

@@U04658@@
（击落飘落在他周围的玫瑰。）

@@U04659@@
鬼火，走开！
啊，你是如此耀眼，直到 Pve 抓住你，
然后你就变成一团粘糊糊的烂摊子
走开，我说！现在！
啊，有沥青和硫磺之类的东西
咬我脖子！
劳斯，IPARimenEZOu 28 ef 9
